chunks: Zayd al-Shahham asked him, so he said to him:
"What is for one who visits one of you?" He said: "Like one who has visited the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family."

key_terms.الشَّحَّامُ: al-Shahham, the epithet of Zayd in the sanad
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.زَيْدٌ: Zayd, the questioning narrator mentioned in the report
key_terms.مِنْكُمْ: from among you; referring to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.وَاحِدًا: one; here meaning one of the Imams

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting one of the Imams according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that visiting one of the Imams is equal in merit to visiting the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. It highlights the exalted spiritual rank of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and their inseparable connection to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
